limitations: Begin again is represented by the same active-save deletion and subsequent startup restore; this narrow migration test does not click the menu UI.
These checks cover application-name migration and valid/invalid JSON/version precedence, not recovery from arbitrary malformed nested gameplay state.
method: Real controller startup _restore_save() and migration methods, using isolated old/stable application save directories. No scene geometry or progression injection is involved.

scenarios.name: begin_again_marker_prevents_reimport
scenarios.reset_method: same active-save deletion used by Begin again; startup restore repeated
